name: precise_benchmark_for_object_level_image_editing
description:
VOCEdits: A benchmark for precise geometric object-level editing
	

Sample format: (input image, edit prompt, input mask, ground-truth output mask, ...)
Please refer to our paper for more details: "📜 POEM: Precise Object-level Editing via MLLM control", SCIA 2025.

	
		
		How to Evaluate?
	

Before evaluation, you should first generate your edited images.
Use datasets library to download dataset. You should only use input image, edit prompt, and id columns to generate edited images.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/monurcan/precise_benchmark_for_object_level_image_editing.
evaluation_method: Mask IoU (mIoU) for mask accuracy; complemented by image similarity/perceptual metrics (LPIPS, FID) and optional human evaluation
reputation: New specialized benchmark for precise object‑level editing (from POEM research); limited adoption so far.
